24:     suite_path: &str,
25:     draft: &str,
26: ) -> Result<TestCaseTree, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
27:     let full_path = Path::new(suite_path).join("tests").join(draft);
28:     if !full_path.exists() {
29:         return Err(format!("Path does not exist: {}", full_path.display()).into());
30:     }
31:     let mut root = TestCaseTree::new();

33:     for entry in WalkDir::new(&full_path).into_iter().filter_map(Result::ok) {
34:         let path = entry.path();
35:         if path.is_file() && path.extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "json") {
36:             let relative_path = path.strip_prefix(&full_path)?;
37:             let file = File::open(path)?;
38:             let reader = BufReader::new(file);
39:             let cases: Vec<Case> = serde_json::from_reader(reader)?;

53:     let mut current = tree;
